quotes.name: Depak Ying
quotes.quote: I’ve noticed more people walking around, especially in the evenings—places like Cozy Pot and HotSlice Pizza seem busier than usual. It feels like there’s a buzz in the air, and businesses are definitely adapting to keep up with the crowd.
